In the dawn of the Two Valleys, the Sun-Bearer and the Earth-Keeper stood separated by the River of Fortune. Each dawn, the Sun-Bearer held five golden seeds. When kept alone, the seeds yielded only enough to sustain one soul. But if cast across the water into the Earth-Keeper’s fertile soil, the river’s magic caused them to bloom threefold into fifteen radiant blossoms.

In the early ages, both guarded their treasures out of fear, knowing the misty currents could distort the sight between their shores. Yet the spirits realized that isolation brought only barren certainty, while shared faith brought abundance. 

Thus, a sacred covenant was struck: the Sun-Bearer would cast all five seeds across the mist, trusting the earth. In return, the Earth-Keeper, blessed with fifteen blossoms, would float half the harvest back across the waters. Seven and a half golden blooms returned, ensuring both flourished in equal, boundless prosperity.

The myth reminds all travelers that true wealth is not preserved through withholding, but multiplied through mutual, reciprocal trust. When both honor the cycle of giving and returning, the misty river divides nothing, but enriches all.

One day, the Sower cast his golden seeds across the gorge into the fertile earth of the Keeper. Touched by the river's water, each kernel miraculously tripled, blooming into a forest of heavy, glowing fruit. 

The Keeper saw the abundance born of the Sower’s leap of faith. Rather than hoarding the harvest in solitude, she gathered the sweetest half of the fruit and floated it back across the water in woven baskets. Both rejoiced, feasting on twice what either could have possessed alone.

Yet the elders tell of a time when fear gripped the Sower's heart, and he buried his seeds in secret. That season, no harvest grew, the river withered to stone, and both starved in the silence of their own distrust.

Since then, the law of the valley remains: send forth the seed without fear, and return the harvest with honor, for only through shared bounty does the world flourish.
